full_judgment: Appellant Shamsun Nahar alias Falani was the principal defendant in Title Suit No.325 of 1987 instituted by the respondent no. 1 to 8 Ahmed Peari and others in the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka. The suit was for declaration of title to and recovery of khas possession of a four-storied building at 93/ka, Arambagh within the city of Dhaka.
